title: Lead AWS Platform Architect
description:
Our client is seeking a remote Lead AWS Platform Architect to provide senior technical leadership for a mission-critical cloud platform in a remote work environment.

This is a hands-on architecture and platform-engineering role focused on AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, security, and federal cloud compliance. The platform is highly automated, with infrastructure and application changes managed through code, peer review, and deployment pipelines rather than manual console configuration.

The Lead AWS Platform Architect will take ownership of platform architecture and implementation across multiple AWS environments, helping guide the evolution toward a secure multi-account federal cloud architecture.

The right candidate is equally comfortable designing cloud architecture and implementing it. You should be able to move from architecture decisions and Terraform modules to EKS operations, GitOps workflows, CI/CD security controls, and production troubleshooting.

Success in this role means delivering secure, reliable, highly automated cloud infrastructure while raising engineering standards across architecture, security, change control, automation, and operational evidence.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a senior technical lead for AWS platform architecture, engineering, security, and automation.

  • Own and evolve Terraform across multi-environment and multi-account AWS infrastructure.

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, dependencies, lifecycle, and infrastructure drift.

  • Safely reconcile existing AWS resources with Infrastructure as Code.

  • Design, operate, and improve production Amazon EKS environments.

  • Manage EKS networking, autoscaling, add-ons, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, upgrades, and cluster lifecycle.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS networking and identity patterns.

  • Support IAM, workload identity, network isolation, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

  • Develop and extend GitOps deployment models using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Design and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Implement automated security controls including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy-as-code, and deployment gates.

  • Support secure container supply-chain practices including image validation, signing, and deployment controls.

  • Help design and implement a federal multi-account AWS landing-zone architecture.

  • Develop approaches for cross-account identity, networking, environment isolation, and controlled promotion between development, testing, and production environments.

  • Work with AWS services including VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, Lambda, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support cloud-native, containerized, microservices, and serverless architectures.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and continuous security visibility across the platform.

  • Support the technical implementation of controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate requirements.

  • Produce and maintain technical evidence supporting security assessments, compliance reviews, and ATO activities.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, GitOps, CI/CD, and security issues.

  • Mentor engineers and provide technical direction on cloud architecture, automation, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Improve engineering standards around peer review, change management, deployment validation, documentation, and evidence-based operations.

  • Collaborate with developers, security teams, architects, program stakeholders, and other technical personnel.

  • Perform other related technical responsibilities as assigned.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or a related discipline, including senior ownership of production environments.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience engineering and supporting AWS cloud environments.

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, dependency management, and infrastructure drift remediation.

  • Significant experience operating Amazon EKS or Kubernetes at production scale.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking, workload identity, Helm, autoscaling, ingress, load balancing, and cluster lifecycle management.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related technologies.

  • Experience designing or supporting multi-environment and multi-account AWS architectures.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GitOps using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab CI/CD strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on DevSecOps experience implementing automated security scanning, secrets detection, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, policy-as-code, or pipeline security gates.

  • Experience with Docker and secure containerized application environments.

  • Experience supporting cloud-native, microservices, or serverless architectures.

  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks such as FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and RMF.

  • Familiarity with the technical evidence and controls required to support an Authority to Operate.

  • Strong troubleshooting, architecture, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating AWS Organizations, Control Tower, federal landing zones, or comparable multi-account architectures.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or FedRAMP-authorized cloud environments.

  • Experience with container supply-chain security, SBOMs, image signing, admission control, or AWS Signer.

  • Experience with CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable observability platforms.

  • Experience supporting FISMA Moderate or other regulated production environments.

  • Experience with high-availability, mission-critical cloud systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific, environmental, weather, geospatial, or other data-intensive systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific data formats such as GRIB or NetCDF.

  • Relevant AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps certifications.

Work Authorization / Security Clearance Requirements

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

title: Teach English From Home !
description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

Position Overview

As a Junior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build and ship AI-enabled software across client engagements and internal products, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow.

You will take clearly scoped tasks, ask good questions, and deliver working code across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Over time, you will take on larger pieces of work with less guidance.

This is an individual contributor role for an early-career engineer who learns fast, cares about quality, and wants real production experience in applied AI.

Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Build and fix frontend and backend features for AI-enabled applications, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Help integrate large language model APIs, prompts, and simple AI workflows into products.
  • Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and cloud deployments on well-defined tasks.
  • Use AI tools daily for coding support, debugging, research, test generation, and documentation.
  • Ask clarifying questions early and raise blockers quickly.
  • Keep documentation, tickets, and status updates current.
  • Learn the team's engineering patterns and apply them consistently.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects (internships, freelance, open source, or personal projects count).
  • Working knowledge of a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend language (such as Python or Node.js).
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, and authentication.
  • Some hands-on experience calling a large language model API (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) in a project.
  • Comfortable with Git and GitHub for daily collaboration.
  • Clear written and spoken English with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Active daily use of AI tools for coding, debugging, and learning.
  • Ability to check AI-generated code for correctness instead of accepting it as is.
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A project that uses retrieval (RAG), embeddings, or a simple AI agent.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

Schedule and Location

  • This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements.
  • Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays.

Technical Requirements

  • Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed.
  • Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher.
  • Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage.
  • Dual-monitor setup preferred.
  • Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).
  • 1080p webcam and working microphone.
  • Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions.

Benefits

  • Compensation: USD 10,000 per year base salary + Performance Bonus
  • Remote work with earned flexibility.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Paid time off.

Why Join Ajaia

You will start your career building real AI products that reach production, with senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow fast. You will see both client delivery and internal product work, and build the range that strong AI engineers need.

The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy.

Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.

title: Senior Manager Smart Building H/F
description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.e.s. Vous piloterez opérationnellement les missions, participerez activement au développement commercial, au marketing de l’offre et au développement de l’expertise au sein du cabinet.

Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

Vos principales responsabilités

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire progresser des consultants.
  • Réalisation des rendez-vous d’avant-vente et aux phases de qualification.
  • Pilotage de la rédaction des propositions commerciales et des réponses aux appels d’offres.
  • Structurer les démarches, charges, livrables et dispositifs d’intervention.
  • Présenter les propositions aux clients et défendre les choix méthodologiques.
  • Développer des offres, méthodes, référentiels et convictions autour du Smart Building.
  • Participer à la veille technologique, réglementaire et concurrentielle.

2.Pilotage de mission de conseil et cadrage stratégique

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.
  • Construire une vision cible du bâtiment intelligent adaptée à leurs priorités et à leur patrimoine.
  • Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité Smart Building et Digital Workplace.
  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur :
    • performance énergétique ;
    • optimisation de l’occupation et des espaces ;
    • confort et qualité des environnements intérieurs ;
    • maintenance prédictive ;
    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer à la construction des trajectoires d'ambition digitales.

3.Pilotage de conception fonctionnelle et architecture Smart Building

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.
  • Formaliser les cas d’usage, parcours utilisateurs et exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Participer à la définition des architectures fonctionnelles et applicatives.
  • Définir les principes d’articulation entre :
    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

  • Participer à la consultation et à la sélection de fournisseurs, intégrateurs et éditeurs.

  • Piloter les risques, dépendances, arbitrages et plans d’action.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance.
  • Suivre la réalisation des pilotes, démonstrateurs et déploiements.
  • Préparer les phases de recette fonctionnelle et de mise en service.
  • Vérifier l’alignement des solutions déployées avec les usages et la vision initiale.

  • Comprendre les attentes des occupants, exploitants et gestionnaires.
  • Concevoir des parcours de services simples et cohérents.
  • Animer des ateliers de design de services ou de co-construction.
  • Participer à la définition des modalités d’adoption des nouveaux services numériques.
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans l’évolution de leurs pratiques.
  • Mesurer l’usage, la satisfaction et la valeur créée après le déploiement.

  • Formation supérieure Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce, université ou formation spécialisée en immobilier, bâtiment, numérique ou systèmes d’information.
  • Expérience professionnelle de 10 ans minimum, acquise dans le conseil, l’immobilier, l’ingénierie, l’intégration de solutions ou la transformation digitale.
  • Expérience significative sur des projets Smart Building, Smart Workplace, immobilier numérique, IoT, performance énergétique ou exploitation technique.
  • Expérience de pilotage de missions, de lots ou de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Une expérience en management en cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important.

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
  • Aptitude à comprendre et à articuler des enjeux métiers, immobiliers et technologiques.
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.
  • Capacité à animer des ateliers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction.
  • Pédagogie et capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets techniques complexes.
  • Autonomie dans la conduite des missions.

  • Goût du travail collectif et des environnements pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à structurer et sécuriser des projets complexes.
  • Curiosité pour les innovations, les usages et les évolutions du marché.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission:

Our marketing team ships at a high cadence across paid, email, events, organic social, and web. In 2026 we built the strategic creative direction. In 2027 we need production horsepower—designers who turn that direction into volume, fast, using AI as leverage. The ideal candidate is a builder first and foremost, not an abstract strategist. This role reports to AfterShip’s Manager of Creative.

What You’ll Do:

  • Performance marketing ad creative (static + simple motion) for paid channels.
  • UI snippets that showcase our product benefits, used across channels.
  • Demand gen campaign creative including campaign identity + asset development.
  • Web asset development + templated wireframes leveraging our core design system.
  • Other assets as needed: organic social assets, email marketing assets, IRL event graphics.
  • Contributing to the build out of AI-native production workflows — pushing Claude Design, Midjourney, Runway, Figma AI, and whatever’s next to the limit.

description:
6-Month Contract | Potential Full-Time Opportunity | Remote (US)

Engagement: Six-month contract, approximately 40 hours per week, with potential extension or conversion to permanent employment

Location: Remote, United States, with substantial Eastern Time business-hour overlap

Start: As soon as possible

We're looking for a highly experienced, hands-on DevSecOps / AWS Platform Engineer to help strengthen and modernize our cloud infrastructure, application security, and development operations.

This engagement encompasses two major initiatives: improving our cloud and application security infrastructure and migrating business-critical legacy systems into AWS.

You'll work closely with our engineering and technology leadership teams, with significant autonomy to recommend solutions, make technical decisions, and implement improvements.

This is not a purely advisory or architectural role. We want an engineer who enjoys designing solutions, writing code, automating infrastructure, and delivering working systems.

While initially structured as a six-month contract, we're building a long-term internal technology capability, and the right candidate may have an opportunity to transition into a permanent position.

Cloud & Application Security

  • Evaluate and strengthen application and AWS security, including identity, authorization, data protection, and infrastructure controls.
  • Implement automated security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities.
  • Embed security practices into our development workflows without unnecessarily slowing delivery.

AWS Infrastructure & Migration

  • Design secure, reliable, cost-effective AWS infrastructure supporting modern applications and traditional business systems.
  • Implement infrastructure as code, backup and recovery, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Coordinate migration testing, validation, cutover, and stabilization with internal stakeholders.

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management.
  • Integrate security scanning and automated safeguards into development workflows.
  • Establish practical infrastructure standards and reusable deployment patterns.
  • Support cloud infrastructure needs for applications incorporating generative AI and agentic workflows.
  • Document architecture, operating procedures, and technical decisions so our internal team can maintain and evolve the environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines.
  • Strong AWS expertise, including networking, compute, databases, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating production workloads from legacy or third-party environments into AWS, preferably including Windows-based applications.
  • Practical experience implementing application and cloud security controls.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD systems, automated security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of backup, disaster recovery, production monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate with a small, fast-moving engineering team.

Especially Valuable, Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or other AI infrastructure.
  • Secure development practices involving AI coding tools.
  • Financial application or legacy enterprise system migrations.
  • PCI DSS or SOC 2 readiness experience.
  • Experience balancing security, reliability, infrastructure costs, and rapid product delivery.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

We're a product-driven company making a substantial investment in technology. Our engineering team is small, entrepreneurial, and actively embracing AI-assisted development.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own meaningful technical initiatives from design through production.
  • Work directly with decision-makers with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Influence the architecture and operational foundations of a growing technology platform.
  • Build automated systems and guardrails that make engineers more productive.
  • Potentially grow into a permanent role as our technology organization expands.

We value practical problem-solvers who favor thoughtful, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the initial engagement, we expect to have materially improved our security posture, modernized important AWS infrastructure, advanced or completed our priority migrations, and established more consistent and efficient deployment and operating practices.

Just as importantly, the systems and processes you build should be well-documented, maintainable, and ready for our internal team to operate.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief description of one or two relevant projects you've personally led, particularly involving AWS migration, cloud security, or DevOps automation.

We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate hands-on ownership of complex production environments and sound engineering judgment.

About WorldVia

WorldVia Travel Group is a growing travel technology and services company serving thousands of independent travel advisors, travel entrepreneurs, and corporate travel clients.

We're investing heavily in our next generation of technology, including an integrated advisor operating platform, consumer travel applications, and AIVIA, our AI-powered workspace.

Our technology strategy centers on AWS, modern software development, automation, and AI. We're building a platform designed to transform how travel professionals operate their businesses.

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. title: New Business Manager
description:
Our company

Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search — across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form.

Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs.

Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries.

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕).


About the role

We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency or a martech company and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process."

On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side end-to-end: prospecting and building your own pipeline, working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn.

You will be responsible for:

  • Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting.

  • Prospect actively: research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and open conversations with agencies and in-house teams that haven’t reached out to us yet.

  • Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies.

  • Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.

  • Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.

  • Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).

  • No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.

  • Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).

  • Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

What we offer:

We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics:

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

Contract: We work exclusively on B2B (contractor) agreements. This means you’ll need your own registered business (e.g. sole proprietorship / self-employed status in your country) and will invoice us monthly.

We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours.

Location and Remote Work:

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
description:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.
